question: What security assessment must a vendor complete, depending on the classification of data it will handle?
expected_answer: Public or Internal data: the VSQ-Lite questionnaire (30 questions). Confidential data: the full VSQ-Full questionnaire (120 questions) plus evidence of a SOC 2 Type II audit completed within the past 12 months. Restricted data: all Confidential-tier requirements plus an on-site (or virtual) security audit by the NovaTech Security Team. Assessments are done before engagement and annually thereafter.
actual_answer:
The required security assessment depends on the classification of the data the vendor will handle:

*   **Public or Internal data:** Vendors must complete the NovaTech Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ-Lite, 30 questions).
*   **Confidential data:** Vendors must complete the full NovaTech Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ-Full, 120 questions) and provide evidence of a SOC 2 Type II audit completed within the past 12 months.
*   **Restricted data:** Vendors must meet all Confidential-tier requirements plus undergo an on-site (or virtual) security audit conducted by the NovaTech Security Team.
